stations.title: Kasimir
stations.say: Why is ticket 3101 on here twice?
stations.note: The bench list is a mess.

stations.title: A plain vector
stations.text: Any line can add, change or clear it.

stations.title: The bench
stations.text: One repair per ticket, kept that way.

captions: Kasimir finds ticket 3101 on the bench list twice.
The list is a plain vector, so any line of the program can add to it or clear it.
You write a bench class that owns its repairs and changes them only by its own rules.
Now ticket 3101 is on the bench once, and the list cannot be cleared by accident.
The repair and the bench keep their own rules now. Classes are yours to build.
